source: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 140-2023 accompanying files: Std140_AE_Files/Informative Materials/Std140_AE_FCSZ_Results.xlsx, sheet 'QAS' (coil loads, detailed outputs) and the sheets of the example programs (QAS, DEEAP, DeST, DOE22, Eplus).
